elements.text: The Need for a European Policy
1985: Completion of Internal Market — Community Legislation on Foodstuffs: Public Health, Consumer Information, Controls of Foodstuffs
BSE Crisis (1986 onwards) — call for safe food on the EU market
Green Paper 1997: called for Food Law to address: public health; free circulation of goods; scientific basis (evidence and risk assessment); competitiveness, HACCP
